programmes.d: When Linda Culbertson calls police about an invasion at her workplace, they assume she is a victim. However, police discover that Linda hired two men to stage the attack.

US detectives investigate cases that remained unsolved for years and decades. In 2003, as the area of Hamblen County, Tennessee struggles with the growing opioid crisis, the body of a local woman is discovered.
The year 1990 is supposed to be a new beginning for Sharon Gill, but this changes in a matter of minutes when she is discovered brutally murdered in her home.
The body of Ricky Ridings is discovered shot and abandoned in his truck and the investigators are led down a path of organised crime to catch the killer.
In 1994, the residents of East Greenbush, New York, were shocked to find Wilomeana Filkins dead and badly beaten. A long, arduous investigation into the case begins.
In 1992, California, a woman's decomposed body was found. Ruled as accidental, police would later connect it to one of California's most prolific serial killers.
Jason Webster was an undergraduate who became obsessed with mature student, Rebecca love. When Rebecca rejected his advances, he murdered her in a drunken rage.
Buck Ruxton was a well-respected GP and was greatly admired by his patients. But behind his respectable exterior, there lurked a duplicitous and jealous man.
When a sexual assault investigation jeopardises Robert Henry Davies' new life and threatens to revisit sins of his past, a reign of terror begins, culminating in a murder.
Margaret McWilliam is killed while jogging, and a long line of sex offenders from the area await questioning.
Officer Arntfield and his team reopen the unsolved murder of Professor David Buller from 2001.
Jackie English was last seen getting into a car after her shift, her sister hopes that Jackie's diary can help.
Nadine Gurczenski's body was found in a ditch three weeks after the search began. Arntfield and his team try to help her family find closure 14 years later.
Arntfield investigates the death of a nurse that was made to look like suicide.
Parents of a college student have been trying to keep the police investigating their daughters murder, which took place over 40 years ago.
Gary Adams left home one night in 2003 and never returned. His mother Jo-Ann struggled to convince the police he was more than a runaway and pleaded with Ron Iddles to investigate.
A bizarre murder case began when police attended the scene of a dog barking outside a camper van. Inside, they found its owner, Tony Robinson, murdered.
Despite only being trialled and convicted for the death of a single victim, Mary Ann Cotton is often classed as Britain's worst female serial killer.
In the 1970s, a murderer terrorised Edinburgh, killing young women in what became known as 'The World's End Murders'. 37 years later, Angus Sinclair would be convicted.
A mother and daughter are brutally murdered in their Palm Beach, Florida home as the area braces for the impact of Hurricane Andrew.
During the rainy season in southern Minnesota, an unidentified female body is discovered near the rural city of Blue Earth.
A young woman goes missing after a night out at a local bar in Maplewood, Minnesota. Weeks later, her dismembered body is found on top of a frozen pond.
In 2010, a historic snowstorm event cripples the Mid-Atlantic region. At the same time, a violent predator takes this opportunity to stalk unsuspecting victims in Virginia.
Years after Jessica Arredondo's body is found, another young woman is reported missing. Investigators uncover a link between the cases and stop a predator driven to kill.
On a perfect New York summer day, a young wife mysteriously disappears. But when a hazy detail comes to light, this missing person's case turns into a homicide investigation.
Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. However, the wound was not self-inflicted.
Investigators piece together evidence found at the scene of a Native American woman's murder. The tyre tracks and shoe impressions could potentially lead them to the killer.
A brilliant young architect became ill and died just before she was about to testify in a criminal trial. See out how the forensics team used evidence to crack this case.
When a dry cleaning employee was raped and murdered in store, eyewitness accounts were inconclusive. Police turned to forensic investigators for answers.
Police believe the death of a millionaire was designed to look like a robbery gone wrong and question if there was more too it.

The disappearance of a young woman led the police to believe she was the victim of a particular criminal, but blood evidence and tyre tracks would prove otherwise.
Two men are convicted of murder after a friend's testimony. Later, a bomb kills the witness' father.
